author: Chandler Independent
title: Tickets on sale for Spirit of Christmas shows in Chandler - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago
Tickets are already on sale for the 39th annual Spirit of Christmas, presented by Christian Dance Academy at the Chandler Center for the Arts on two December weekends.
The holiday show includes a cast of more than 100 dancers, singers, special guest performers and a hoop dancer.
This Christmas tradition also includes elaborate costuming and a set that has a live horse and carriage on stage.
Tickets start at $46 and can be purchased by clicking here.
Show times are 2 p.m. and 7 p.m. on Saturdays, Dec. 12 and Dec. 19, and 2 p.m. only on Sundays, Dec. 13 and 20.
Renovations are under way this summer in the Chandler Center for the Arts theatre spaces. Because part of that process requires shutting off all electricity, box office services will be located at Vision Gallery at Chandler City Hall, 10 E. Chicago Street, downtown until about Sept. 21.
Call 480-782-2680 to learn more.
